verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state agents can be created and managed via API, dashboard, CLI, or hosted MCP server, and that agents can be created 'via the API or the web dashboard' — suggesting strong parity between API and UI. However, some capabilities like the 'visual workflow builder' are described as a UI-only tool, and there is no explicit statement confirming every dashboard feature (e.g., analytics dashboards, testing UI) has a full API/CLI equivalent. Missing for 10: explicit API coverage confirmation for visual workflow building and dashboard-only analytics views, and independent corroboration of full parity.
